Grimarillion Pair Atlas

All 2,080 pairs of the 65 masteries, analysed skill by skill. For each pair it finds the damage skill that gets the most help from the other tree, names the partner skills that actually boost it, and shows how much of each tree is useful. Pairs that hang on a single skill are flagged. Mastery Codex

    How the analysis works

    Every skill was read from the game database at max rank: the damage it deals (types, damage over time counted as its total), the bonuses it grants, resistance it strips from enemies, damage conversions, weapon requirements and whether it hits with your weapon. A skill and its modifiers count as one package.

    For each pair, each class's strongest damage skills are checked against every passive, aura, buff and curse in the other tree. A partner skill counts as help when it boosts that skill's damage types, lowers matching resistances (weighted four times, since resistance reduction is worth more than % damage), adds flat damage to weapon hits, adds the right kind of speed, or boosts pets. Skills that need a weapon the damage skill can't use are skipped.

    Tree use is the share of the partner's skills that help the best damage skill. A pair is flagged when only one partner skill helps, or one skill carries nearly all of it. Tiers are relative: S is the top 5%, then A 15%, B 30%, C 30%, D 20%. This is a guide from the numbers in the files, not tested builds; skill descriptions with special mechanics may be worth more than the numbers show.
